review.S01: Worker projection enumerates only legacy contract fields, excludes future laboratory collections, and keeps hidden rows server-side when merging proposals. Tests cover employee, manager, and chief DTOs, invalid future fields, and preservation of hidden server data.
review.S13: Visible tasks do not grant execution. Task lifecycle, checklist, and timer deltas require an active in-scope responsible person or current replacement; operational entries also validate executor identity. Manager regression covers checklist, transition, timer, and activity attempts.
review.S30: The wait gateway requires an explicit interruption reason for a superior, includes it in the allowlisted receipt arguments, and rejects a replay that changes the reason. SQL stores the reason and closes the real executor's active clock while preserving actor identity and audit details.
review.S31: Strict task DTO validators enforce status/completedAt consistency, blocker and date relationships, timestamp ordering, and coordination responsibility/share relationships while accepting valid historical cases covered by fixtures.
review.S32: The coordinated-task DTO distinguishes current and legacy coverage; replacement-only coverage receives zero contribution while a participant retains their frozen share. SQL activation tests cover legacy absence and simultaneous participant-plus-replacement cases.
review.S44: RemoteWorkspace rejects stale reads after view changes and stale polling results during an in-flight write; the proposal remains visible and recoverable across a remount.
review.S45: The UI rejects DTOs whose activeId does not resolve to an active profile and retains unconfirmed proposals after invalid server responses.
review.S46: Worker presence read/write failures are isolated from workspace persistence; GET/POST still return valid state with empty presence while auth or workspace-storage failures remain errors.
review.S59: Migration 012 validates non-null positive revisions, then rechecks request revision/status and current authority after coordination locks. The change-request flow locks the request and revalidates team scope before writes; approval revalidates privileged session, revision, and owner status after locks.
review.S60: Activity receipts replay by actor and operation ID, reject changed arguments, and create independent entries for distinct operation IDs even when content is equal. Legacy wrappers retain their behavior.
